description: Enhanced parameter arity validation: missing/extra arguments across multiple operations, both switches set simultaneously, allowLessParams binding integer defaults to zero, allowExtraParams trimming surplus args on multi-argument methods, and the empty-params-without-relaxation rejection.

cases.description: addInts with no params is rejected as params-invalid
cases.expected_output:
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32602
error_category=method_params_invalid
error_message=method parameters invalid

cases.description: addInts with three positional args is rejected as params-invalid
cases.expected_output:

error_message=method parameters invalid
